content.text:
The company wants contract_research with company_owns IP. My hard limit allows contract_research, so that's fine. But I want university ownership. I need to change ip to uni_owns and adjust publication review days (60 is acceptable, I can keep it). Let me change ip and keep other things mostly the same, trading on exclusivity perhaps.

I can change at most two fields. Let me change:
1. ip: from contract_research_company_owns to company_owns_uni_academic_use (this is a compromise - company owns but uni keeps academic use rights, which fits contract_research context)
2. publication: reduce reviewDays from 60 to 30
Actually, I should push harder for uni_owns_option_to_licence instead, while still cutting the publication review period to 30 days.
